description: This file is a Java test class for integration testing loan rescheduling functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It contains setup methods, utility functions, and multiple test cases that verify loan rescheduling behavior under various scenarios such as interest recovery, recalculations, and loan status restrictions.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleOnDecliningBalanceLoanTest
classes.description: Integration test class for loan rescheduling scenarios specifically for declining balance loans in Fineract.
